messages:
Maya: Quick sync — final acceptance funnel for the upcoming GA. Need signoff on SLA targets, docs, support tiers, monitoring checks, and pricing rubric. Who can own each by EOD Tue? :wave:
Evan: I can take SLO/SLA definitions. Quick Q — do we want to lock p50/p90/p99 targets now or leave p99 open? I propose Hosted: p50 <100ms, p90 <300ms, p99 <700ms; availability 99.9%. Dedicated: tighter latencies and 99.95% availability.
Maya: @Evan sounds reasonable as a starting point. We'll iterate if finance/ops push back.
Luca: I'll run the billing sensitivity once I have QPS and token mix. Can someone paste the expected traffic profile or rough percent of long vs short requests?
Zoe: Support readiness: I can own runbooks + escalation ladder. Need to know who is on primary oncall after GA so I can draft rotations.
Priya: Docs will publish GA guide (getting-started, SLA matrix, troubleshooting, billing FAQ). ETA for first draft: Thu. Need legal to review SLA wording.
Evan: Monitoring/alerting: we should add synthetics for latency, error rate, and fallback-to-backup-model. Traces must include tenant_id and model_version tag. Also flag unusual token spike.
Alex: I can add a synthetic job from three regions. Need endpoint URL + API key and the check cadence (I suggest every 5m). Example cron: `0 */5 * * *`.
Maya: Action list summary: SLA (Evan), Billing rubric & credits policy (Luca), Docs (Priya), Support runbooks & oncall (Zoe), Monitoring synthetics (Alex). I'll make a consolidated checklist tomorrow. Please confirm owners + due dates here.
Zoe: Support runbooks first pass: Wed EOD. Will include playbook for model fallback, degraded latency, and billing dispute flow.
Priya: Docs draft: Thu 12:00. I'll include an SLA one-pager and an exceptions section for model updates/3rd-party outages.
Luca: Finance: will post pricing/billing spreadsheet Wed 12:00. Draft credit policy: cap credits to 1% monthly revenue, manual review above $10k.
Evan: Confirming SLA numbers above. Also propose a 90-day "launch grace" where we offer a modest credits buffer for early customers while smoothing quantization/config tuning.
Maya: Product + GTM asked for a grace period — add to acceptance as a decision to be finalized. Also need to confirm which metrics are gated for GA (SLOs + observability coverage + docs + billing flows).
Priya: Note for legal: SLA wording must include exception clause for force majeure and model updates. I'll tag legal on the doc review.
Luca: Also need to align on pricing tiers tied to SLA levels (e.g., standard vs premium with faster support and higher availability). Will draft proposals in the spreadsheet.
deploy-bot: deployment succeeded: canary -> prod at 2026-03-20T21:03:00Z
Evan: FYI canary warmed caches but synthetic checks failing in eu-west-1 (timeouts). Investigating.
Alex: Looking into region config and routing. Sending logs to #eng-infra.
Zoe: If eu-west is rate-limited, we should have a customer-facing note ready (Priya), and an internal incident runbook step (me).
Maya: Good catch — temporarily move that check to 'observability issue' in the acceptance checklist. We still need core gating: docs, SLA text, billing policy, support runbooks, monitoring synthetics green in primary regions.
Priya: Will prepare a short public-facing GA checklist snippet for marketing once items are locked.
Maya: I will publish the consolidated acceptance checklist tomorrow morning and ping PM leads. Keeping this thread for acceptance items only. Thanks all :thumbsup:
